title: status-list-server Helm chart values
description: Configuration values for the status-list-server Helm chart. This schema mirrors the inline documentation in values.yaml; keep the two in sync.

domain.title: Public DNS suffix
domain.description: Chart-wide public DNS suffix. When set, the default ingress host becomes statuslist.<domain> and the default TLS host becomes *.<domain>. Leave empty for provider-neutral defaults. Rendered hostnames are normalized to lowercase.

podAnnotations.title: Pod annotations
podAnnotations.description: Optional annotations merged onto the Pod template metadata (top-level, distinct from statuslist.podLabels which go into the pod labels). Consumed by deployment.yaml on top of the always-emitted prometheus.io/scrape annotations. Defaults to an empty map; overlays supply the annotations. Values may be strings or booleans.

serviceAccount.title: ServiceAccount
serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount for the application pods, used to attach Workload Identity role annotations (EKS IRSA, GCP WI, Azure WI) for ambient cloud credentials. Workload Identity also needs the cloud-side trust relationship keyed on the ServiceAccount name (default: chart fullname).

create.title: Create the ServiceAccount
create.description: true renders the ServiceAccount and injects serviceAccountName (default: chart fullname, or name). false with an empty name injects no serviceAccountName, so the pod runs as the namespace default ServiceAccount.

name.title: ServiceAccount name
name.description: Explicit ServiceAccount name. Defaults to the chart fullname (via _helpers.tpl). This is the name the cloud identity trust relationship is keyed on.

automountServiceAccountToken.title: Automount SA token
automountServiceAccountToken.description: Default false: the application does not need the Kubernetes API, so the SA bearer token is not mounted (NSA/CISA hardening, CIS 5.1.6). Does not break Workload Identity, which uses projected OIDC tokens.

annotations.title: ServiceAccount annotations
annotations.description: Workload Identity annotations, e.g. EKS IRSA eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn, GKE iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account, AKS azure.workload.identity/client-id.

statuslist.title: Application configuration
statuslist.description: Configuration for the status-list-server application deployment and its pod.

enabled.title: Deploy the application
enabled.description: Whether to render the application Deployment and related resources.

replicaCount.title: Replica count
replicaCount.description: Number of application replicas. Omitted when autoscaling.enabled=true so the HPA controls the replica count.

initContainers.title: Init containers
initContainers.description: Optional init containers. NOTE: deployment.yaml hardens each entry via mustMergeOverwrite, which REPLACES user-supplied resources, volumeMounts, and securityContext with the chart's hardened defaults.

podLabels.title: Pod labels
podLabels.description: Extra labels merged onto the Pod template metadata. For Azure Workload Identity, azure.workload.identity/use must be a quoted string, e.g. "true", not a boolean.

image.title: Application image
image.description: Image and image-resolution settings. Resolution precedence: digest (repository@digest, IfNotPresent), then tag (repository:tag, Always), then derived from Chart.appVersion + variant. An invalid digest fails the render.

pullPolicy.title: Pull policy
pullPolicy.description: Empty derives from resolution: IfNotPresent for a digest, Always for a mutable tag. Set explicitly to override.

variant.title: Image variant
variant.description: Provider/database variant used to derive the default tag suffix when tag and digest are empty: fscert, aws, gcp, azure, vault. Only PostgreSQL variants are published; a MySQL backend requires an explicit tag or digest.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Explicit image tag (with variant suffix, e.g. 1.2.0-aws). Empty derives <baseAppVersion>-<variant> from Chart.appVersion.

digest.title: Image digest
digest.description: sha256:<64 hex chars>. Takes precedence over tag and pins the exact digest CI scanned. If set, it must be a valid sha256 digest or the render fails.

service.title: Application Service
service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the application pod. The Ingress routes to service.port, which forwards to service.targetPort (the container port matching APP_SERVER__PORT).

type.title: Service type
type.description: ClusterIP keeps traffic behind Ingress TLS; NodePort / LoadBalancer expose directly (NodePort requires nodePort).

targetPort.title: Target container port
targetPort.description: Port (or named container port) the Service forwards to; must match the application http containerPort and APP_SERVER__PORT.

ingress.title: Ingress
ingress.description: NGINX Ingress exposing the application. Host defaults to statuslist.<global.domain> when set, otherwise localhost. TLS hosts default to *.<global.domain> when global.domain is set, or to the rendered ingress host when secretName is set explicitly.

annotations.title: Ingress annotations
annotations.description: NGINX/cert-manager annotations, e.g. cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer and nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect.

hosts.title: TLS hostnames
hosts.description: Explicit TLS hostnames. Empty defaults to *.<global.domain>, or to the rendered ingress host when secretName is set.

secretName.title: TLS secret name
secretName.description: Empty keeps the neutral default render HTTP-only. Set in overlays that provide TLS material or cert-manager ingress-shim annotations.

externalDnsHostname.title: Explicit ingress hostname
externalDnsHostname.description: Defaults to statuslist.<global.domain> when set, otherwise localhost. Besides emitting the external-dns hostname annotation, this also sets APP_SERVER__DOMAIN when not set in statuslist.env, so it changes application config too.

env.title: Application environment variables
env.description: Environment for the status-list-server container. APP_DATABASE__BACKEND selects the backend (postgres | mysql). APP_DATABASE__HOST/PORT/USERNAME/NAME default to the active backend's values when omitted. Do NOT set APP_DATABASE__URL or APP_DATABASE__PASSWORD here; the chart rejects them and delivers the password via APP_DATABASE__PASSWORD_FILE / the fallback Secret.

aws.title: AWS application configuration
aws.description: Optional AWS configuration for the application. The base chart is provider-neutral: Workload Identity (IRSA) is not configured by default. This block is only for the legacy static shared-credential-file path.

mountCredentials.title: Mount static AWS credential files
mountCredentials.description: Mounts aws-credentials-secret into the pod and sets AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE / AWS_CONFIG_FILE. In ESO mode the chart also renders the ExternalSecret that provisions that Secret. Do NOT combine with IRSA/Workload Identity (shared files resolve before web-identity tokens).

credentialsSecret.title: AWS credentials secret source
credentialsSecret.description: Remote-source layout of the dedicated aws-credentials-secret when mountCredentials=true and externalSecret.enabled.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: Plain (non-secret) AWS region. APP_AWS__REGION is injected into the pod only when secretStore.provider=aws AND an effective region is set (this value, or the legacy secretStore.aws.region fallback). Leave empty for pure-IRSA / Workload Identity so the SDK discovers the region from instance metadata.

fallbackSecret.title: Fallback Secret
fallbackSecret.description: Fallback Kubernetes Secret for clusters that do not run External Secrets Operator. Only rendered when externalSecret.enabled=false AND fallbackSecret.enabled=true (the chart fails if both are enabled). Always named statuslist-secret; PostgreSQL (postgres.auth.existingSecret) references the same name.

generatedCertificate.title: Generated self-signed certificate
generatedCertificate.description: Local/dev helper for the fscert image that includes a self-signed certificate and signing key. GitOps deployments should not use generated material because helm template runs without cluster lookup and can regenerate values on each sync.

stringData.title: Secret string data
stringData.description: Plain-string Secret values (the API server base64-encodes them). Empty postgres-password means the chart generates a random password and reuses an existing one on upgrades when the cluster is reachable; GitOps tools cannot look up, so provide an explicit password or use ESO.

secretMounts.title: File-based secret mounts
secretMounts.description: Mount Kubernetes Secrets as files into the container for production credential/key rotation. fileEnv maps a mounted file path into an application env var; paths are relative to mountPath and must match the mounted items. secretMounts is dynamic and may mount arbitrary secret names.

fileEnv.title: Environment variable to mounted file mapping
fileEnv.description: Map an env var name to a file path relative to mountPath. Each value must match a mounted items path, be relative, normalized, and resolve inside mountPath (the chart fails otherwise).

database.title: Database password key
database.description: Default Secret key used when a database password item omits key.

watcher.title: Credential rotation watcher
watcher.description: Watcher configuration for file-based credential rotation detection. When pollIntervalSecs is set, APP_WATCHER__POLL_INTERVAL_SECS is injected. Requires an application image implementing the file watcher contract (the current published images do not watch files yet).

pollIntervalSecs.title: Poll interval
pollIntervalSecs.description: Seconds between file-reload polls; injected as APP_WATCHER__POLL_INTERVAL_SECS.

livenessProbe.title: Liveness probe
livenessProbe.description: HTTP GET on /health/live (port http). Override the whole block to customize.

readinessProbe.title: Readiness probe
readinessProbe.description: HTTP GET on /health/ready (port http). Override the whole block to customize.

networkPolicy.title: NetworkPolicy
networkPolicy.description: Opt-in NetworkPolicy (default OFF). When enabled and ingress is empty, a port-only rule allows ANY source in the cluster, so you MUST restrict ingress to your ingress controller. Egress always allows 443/53 to 0.0.0.0/0; egressInternal is appended to the database-port rule and inherits that port; databaseEgress is required for MySQL/external databases.

ingress.title: Ingress from selectors
ingress.description: When empty (and enabled=true), ANY source can reach the service port. Add podSelector/namespaceSelector/ipBlock entries to restrict sources.

egressInternal.title: Additional internal egress to selectors
egressInternal.description: Appended to the DATABASE egress rule, so each entry inherits the database port. External ports 443/53 are always allowed without destination restriction.

databaseEgress.title: Explicit database egress destinations
databaseEgress.description: Required for MySQL or external databases (RDS, Cloud SQL, another namespace, operator-managed), where the chart cannot infer the target.

externalSecret.title: External Secrets Operator mode
externalSecret.description: ESO delivery mode, mutually exclusive with statuslist.fallbackSecret (the chart fails if both are enabled). When enabled the chart renders an ExternalSecret that syncs the application Secret (always named statuslist-secret, holder of the database password) from the secret manager referenced by secretStore. Cloud credential resolution depends on the provider (Workload Identity / IRSA / ManagedIdentity where supported; Vault token auth and Azure ServicePrincipal use static secrets). With a namespaced SecretStore, externalSecret.enabled REQUIRES secretStore.enabled; only a pre-existing ClusterSecretStore is exempt.

secretStoreRef.title: SecretStore reference
secretStoreRef.description: References a namespace SecretStore (rendered by this chart) or a pre-existing cluster-scoped ClusterSecretStore (not rendered here).

name.title: Target secret name
name.description: Single supported application-secret name shared with the Deployment, PostgreSQL, and the fallback Secret. Any other value fails at render time; intentionally not configurable.

creationPolicy.title: Creation policy
creationPolicy.description: Passed through to the ExternalSecret CRD. Accepts the ESO-supported values (e.g. Owner, Merge, None, Orphan, CreateOrMerge). No enum is enforced here so valid CRD values are not dropped.

extraExternalSecrets.title: Extra ExternalSecrets
extraExternalSecrets.description: Optional additional ExternalSecret resources for separately mounted Secrets (file-based database credentials, token signing keys, API keys). Each entry renders as its own ExternalSecret and may override refreshInterval and secretStoreRef.

secretStore.title: SecretStore
secretStore.description: External Secrets Operator namespace-scoped SecretStore CR, rendered only when externalSecret.enabled AND secretStore.enabled (and secretStoreRef.kind is SecretStore, not ClusterSecretStore).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: Region for the ESO AWS SecretStore. A real default, not a formality: ESO calls Secrets Manager here, and when both this and statuslist.aws.region are empty it falls back to eu-central-1 at the CR level. APP_AWS__REGION is injected into the pod only when secretStore.provider=aws AND a region is effective.

authType.title: Azure auth type
authType.description: ServicePrincipal | ManagedIdentity | WorkloadIdentity (per the ESO AzureKVProvider CRD).

serviceAccountRef.title: ESO controller ServiceAccount reference
serviceAccountRef.description: References the External Secrets Operator controller's own ServiceAccount (least privilege), not the application ServiceAccount. Set namespace only when ESO is in a different namespace.

raw.description: Full ESO provider spec passthrough for unsupported providers (secretStore.provider=raw). Holds ONLY the concrete provider body rendered directly under spec.provider (no extra top-level 'provider' key), e.g. { webhook: { url: '...' } }. Render-time validation rejects an empty/raw-only object to avoid emitting an insecure SecretStore.

postgres.title: Bundled PostgreSQL
postgres.description: Bundled in-cluster PostgreSQL (the CloudPirates subchart). One possible backend: the application selects its backend at runtime via APP_DATABASE__* env vars. When APP_DATABASE__BACKEND is unset it defaults to 'postgres', the chart maps USERNAME/NAME from postgres.auth and derives HOST from the release name. Setting APP_DATABASE__BACKEND=mysql while enabled=true FAILS rather than overriding. To use MySQL or another backend, set enabled=false AND explicitly switch APP_DATABASE__BACKEND+APP_DATABASE__HOST (see docs/database-backends.md); merely disabling postgres without switching the backend leaves APP_DATABASE__BACKEND=postgres pointing at the in-cluster postgres service, which no longer exists.

existingSecret.title: Existing secret name
existingSecret.description: Must reference the same secret the application reads (statuslist-secret, see the status-list-server-chart.appSecretName helper). Fixed in fallback mode; in ESO mode keep it in sync with externalSecret.spec.target.name.

storageClass.title: Storage class
storageClass.description: Empty string uses the cluster default StorageClass.

image.title: PostgreSQL image
image.description: Image for the bundled PostgreSQL subchart (default tag 18.0).

mysql.title: External MySQL connection defaults
mysql.description: External MySQL connection defaults used when APP_DATABASE__BACKEND=mysql. This chart does not vendor or deploy MySQL; set APP_DATABASE__HOST to an external Service/host and postgres.enabled=false. No published image variant is built with the mysql feature yet, so a MySQL deployment needs an explicit image tag or digest.

autoscaling.title: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
autoscaling.description: HPA (autoscaling/v2). When enabled the Deployment omits replicas so the HPA controls the count. Scaled pods share the application ServiceAccount; each gets its own short-lived Workload Identity token, so no per-pod cloud registration is required. minReplicas > maxReplicas is rejected at render time.

podDisruptionBudget.title: PodDisruptionBudget
podDisruptionBudget.description: PDB (policy/v1). Use with replicaCount > 1 / HPA so disruption events keep the minimum replicas available. Set exactly one of minAvailable / maxUnavailable; the chart rejects both set or neither set. minAvailable must be < replica count (or autoscaling.minReplicas) or voluntary evictions are blocked; the safe default is maxUnavailable: 1. An explicit 0 is preserved.

serviceMonitor.title: ServiceMonitor
serviceMonitor.description: ServiceMonitor (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) for Prometheus Operator scrape discovery. Prometheus deployments driven by the Operator discover targets through ServiceMonitor CRs rather than annotations; enable to define the /metrics endpoint on the application Service. Set labels.release to match your Prometheus ServiceMonitorSelector.

labels.title: ServiceMonitor labels
labels.description: Selector labels required by your Prometheus ServiceMonitorSelector, e.g. release: kube-prometheus-stack.

interval.title: Scrape interval
interval.description: e.g. '15s'. Empty uses the Operator default.

scrapeTimeout.title: Scrape timeout
scrapeTimeout.description: e.g. '10s'. Empty uses the Operator default.

metricRelabelings.title: Metric relabelings
metricRelabelings.description: Additional metric relabelings applied to scraped metrics (monitoring.coreos.com ServiceMonitor spec.metricRelabelings).

relabelings.title: Target relabelings
relabelings.description: Additional target relabelings applied before scraping (monitoring.coreos.com ServiceMonitor spec.relabelings).

prometheusRule.title: PrometheusRule
prometheusRule.description: PrometheusRule (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) shipping the SLI recording rules and SLO burn-rate / error-budget alerting rules as a single CRD. Alert thresholds come from the slo block; the values.yaml defaults must stay in lockstep with observability/slo/thresholds.json (enforced by CI) and the standalone observability/prometheus/rules/*.rules.yml.

labels.title: PrometheusRule labels
labels.description: Selector labels required by your Prometheus RuleSelector, e.g. release: kube-prometheus-stack.

slo.title: SLO thresholds
slo.description: SLO target thresholds consumed by the prometheusrule template to build SLI recording rules and SLO burn-rate alerting rules. Moving thresholds here changes alert thresholds, but the rule template rounds some via printf "%.3f" and the alert summary strings are hard-coded and do not follow the values. Types accept both numbers and strings because Helm's --set passes floats as strings.

errorRateTarget.title: Error-rate SLO target
errorRateTarget.description: Acceptable ratio of 5xx to all requests over the SLO window (0.005 = 0.5%). Multiplicand of the burn-rate multipliers and denominator of the error-budget success ratio.

fastBurnMultiplier.title: Fast-burn multiplier
fastBurnMultiplier.description: Fast-burn alert triggers when observed error rate exceeds errorRateTarget x this (14.4x) on both the 1h and 5m windows for 5m. Pages.

slowBurnMultiplier.title: Slow-burn multiplier
slowBurnMultiplier.description: Slow-burn alert triggers when observed error rate exceeds errorRateTarget x this (6.0x) on the 6h and 30m windows for 30m. Warns.

requestLatencyP95.title: Request latency P95 target
requestLatencyP95.description: Request latency P95 SLO target in seconds (0.3 = 300ms).

dbLatencyP95.title: DB latency P95 target
dbLatencyP95.description: Database query latency P95 SLO target in seconds (0.05 = 50ms).

cacheHitRatioMin.title: Minimum cache hit ratio
cacheHitRatioMin.description: Minimum acceptable status-list cache hit ratio (0.85 = 85%).

certRenewalFailureMax.title: Cert renewal failure max
certRenewalFailureMax.description: Retained for reference / parity: NOT used by any template or rule.

errorBudgetCriticalThreshold.title: Error-budget critical threshold
errorBudgetCriticalThreshold.description: Remaining-error-budget gate for the ErrorBudget*Critical page alerts (0.1 = 10%).

certExpiryWarnSeconds.title: Certificate expiry warn seconds
certExpiryWarnSeconds.description: Warn when certificate time-to-expiry is below this many seconds (1209600 = 14 days).

certExpiryCriticalSeconds.title: Certificate expiry critical seconds
certExpiryCriticalSeconds.description: Page when certificate time-to-expiry is below this many seconds (604800 = 7 days).

alerting.title: Alerting / AlertmanagerConfig
alerting.description: AlertmanagerConfig for kube-prometheus-stack / Prometheus Operator alert routing. Renders an AlertmanagerConfig CRD that routes SLO alerts to the configured notification channel. Supported platforms: discord, slack, teams, mattermost, webhook, email.

platform.title: Alerting platform
platform.description: discord | slack | teams | mattermost | webhook | email.

dashboardUrl.title: Dashboard URL
dashboardUrl.description: Grafana dashboard URL injected into alert annotations.

channel.title: Slack channel
channel.description: Optional Slack channel override. Leave empty to use the webhook default channel.

existingSecret.title: Existing credentials Secret
existingSecret.description: Name of a pre-existing Secret containing credentials. When set, the chart does NOT render its own Secret and reads webhook-url / dms-webhook-url / smtp-password from it.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Inline webhook URL for discord/slack/teams/mattermost/webhook platforms. Use existingSecret + ESO/Vault in production.

webhookTimeout.title: Webhook timeout
webhookTimeout.description: Per-request timeout for webhook/Teams/Mattermost receivers (Go duration, e.g. '10s').
